Flowpay only triggers your bank\'s *99# / UPI 123 flow — tap to read the full disclaimer.

Flowpay is an open-source app. It does not process payments itself — it only triggers your bank\'s *99# (UPI 123) dialer flow on your behalf. All transactions happen between you, your bank, and your phone. Flowpay accepts no responsibility whatsoever for any transaction outcome. By accepting, you acknowledge this.

Your payment request was sent to the UPI service.\n\nIf your bank calls back, press 1 to confirm and enter your UPI PIN. Flowpay will show the result as soon as your bank\'s confirmation SMS arrives.
Flowpay did not receive a confirmation SMS from your bank. The payment may still have gone through — please check your bank statement or SMS inbox before retrying.
